Name: Stardew Valley VERY Configured (1.5.6)
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4]Stardew Valley VERY Configured (1.5.6) 💐
[/size][/b]
These configuration files are designed specifically for the Vortex collection* [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/collections/g14kxi/][/url][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/collections/9sf9yn/]SVVE & AV Complete 1.5.6[/url]﻿. These configurations are maintained as a separate mod download to also accommodate users who do not utilize Vortex. Bundling them within the collection would restrict access for these users.

Vortex users do not need to download this file separately, they are installed as part of the collection installation process through Vortex.

To use these configurations independently, simply merge the contents of this zip file with your mod folder, which will overwrite any existing configuration files. You must download the mods separately, either through the collection or individually—this is not a modpack and contains no mods. 

*Note: Vortex Collections are distinct from modpacks. Each mod download is counted as a unique download for the creator. JennaJuffuffles' collections and mods are exclusively updated and available through Nexus.
